description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for telemetry data, including ingestion, querying telemetry points, and retrieving rollup records. It uses external services and models for processing and relies on dependency injection for user authentication.

classes.name: RollupRecord
classes.description: Schema model for representing rollup data records.

methods.name: ingest(payload: TelemetryIngest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: HTTP POST endpoint to ingest telemetry data, updates the database, and evaluates thresholds.

methods.name: query(payload: TelemetryQuery, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: HTTP POST endpoint to retrieve telemetry points based on query parameters.

methods.name: rollups(device_id: str, metric: str, period: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, limit: int = 500, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: HTTP GET endpoint to retrieve rollup aggregate data for a device and metric.

ctags.name: ingest
ctags.pattern: /^async def ingest(payload: TelemetryIngest, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user)):$/

ctags.name: rollups
ctags.pattern: /^def rollups(device_id: str, metric: str, period: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, limit: int = 5/
ctags.signature: (device_id: str, metric: str, period: str, start_ts: int, end_ts: int, limit: int = 500, user: UserProfile = Depends(get_current_user))
